claims.claim: 第一届锦标赛有 14 份提交的参赛规则（来自 3 个国家、5 个学科，共 16 位提交者），另由主办方加入 RANDOM，总共 15 条规则进行循环赛。
claims.quote: The fourteen submitted entries came from three countries and five disciplines. The Appendix lists the names a n d affiliations of the sixteen people who submitted these entries
claims.source_title: Axelrod, R. (1980a). Effective Choice in the Prisoner's Dilemma. Journal of Conflict Resolution 24(1): 3-25
claims.notes: 引文来自扫描 PDF 的 OCR 文本层（有 OCR 噪声如 'a n d'），措辞已逐字核对。分母陷阱：'14 entries' 不含 RANDOM；'15 rules' 含 RANDOM（附录第十五名即 RANDOM；正文'just two of the fifteen rules'）。有二手源写错：Tesfatsion 2003 课堂笔记写 'Fourteen entries ... including RANDOM'；Rapoport, Seale & Colman 2015 写 'invited 14 scientists'——实际是 16 人提交 14 份。

claims.claim: 第一届参赛者学科：经济学家、数学家、政治学家、心理学家和一名社会学家；多数招募自发表过博弈论/囚徒困境论文的人。
claims.quote: the best of the fourteen entries from economists, mathematicians, political scientists, psychologists, and a sociologist.
claims.notes: Axelrod & Hamilton 1981 Science 版本只写 'game theorists in economics, sociology, political science, and mathematics'，漏掉了心理学——而 TFT 提交者 Rapoport 本人就在 Toronto 心理学系。口径不一致，以 1980a 为准。

claims.claim: 第一届署名参赛者（按名次）：Rapoport(TFT)、Tideman & Chieruzzi、Nydegger、Grofman、Shubik、Stein & Amnon Rapoport、Friedman、Davis、Graaskamp(本科生)、Downing、Feld、Joss、Tullock、一名匿名政治学研究生；第15名 RANDOM。
claims.quote: Thirteenth Place with 300.5 points is an eighteen-line program entered by Gordon TULLOCK ... Fourteenth Place with 282.2 points is a 77-line program by a graduate student of political science whose dissertation is in game theory.
claims.notes: Tullock 的规则是 Axelrod 邀请他把 Overcast & Tullock 1971 的想法具体化的，'out of scientific interest rather than an expectation that it would be a likely winner'；Downing 条目是 'based on an idea submitted by Leslie DOWNING'。注意第六名的 Amnon Rapoport（UNC 心理学系）不是 Anatol Rapoport——2015 年 PLOS ONE 批评论文的第一作者正是这位 Amnon Rapoport。

claims.claim: 第一届规则：循环赛，每条规则与其他每条、与自身孪生体、与 RANDOM 各对局；每局恰好 200 步；收益 R=3, T=5, S=0, P=1；整个循环赛跑了 5 遍，共 120,000 步、240,000 次选择。
claims.quote: Each game consisted of exactly 200 moves. The payoff matrix for each move awards both players 3 points for mutual cooperation, and 1 point for mutual defection. If one player defects while the other player cooperates, the defecting player receives 5 points and the cooperating player receives 0 points ... the entire round robin tournament was run five times to get a more stable estimate of the scores for each pair of players. In all, there were 120,000 moves, making for 240,000 separate choices.
claims.notes: 120,000 = 120 场对局 ×200 步 ×5 遍（15 条规则含自对局共 120 个无序对）。200 步是事先公布的固定长度——这正是第二届改成概率结束的原因（末局效应）。

claims.claim: TFT 第一届平均每局 504 分（附录精确值 504.5），第二名 Tideman & Chieruzzi 500.4——领先仅约 4 分（<1%）；第三 Nydegger 485.5。基准：全程互相合作 = 600，全程互相背叛 = 200。
claims.quote: First Place with 504.5 points is TIT FOR TAT ... Second Place with 500.4 points is a program of 41 lines by T. Nicolas TIDEMAN and Paula CHIERUZZI ... Third Place with 485.5 points is a 23-line program by Rudy NYDEGGER
claims.notes: 正文写 'averaged 504 points per game'（取整），附录写 504.5。'压倒性胜利'的叙事要小心：冠亚军差距很小。

claims.claim: 'TFT 只有四行代码'在原文中成立，但口径是 FORTRAN 四行；且'最简单'是在提交的程序中——RANDOM 五行、JOSS 五行、DAVIS 六行。
claims.quote: This rule is only four lines long in FORTRAN.
claims.notes: 正文说 'This simplest of all submitted programs'。有二手源写成'五行 Fortran'（Brooklyn CUNY 2005 课程讲义），属误传。另：1980a 同时说'neither the discipline of the author, the brevity of the program, nor its length accounts for a rule's relative success'——即简短本身不是成功原因（OCR 原文 brevity/length 并列）。

claims.claim: 第一届前八名全部是 'nice'（不率先背叛，至少在最后几步之前），其余七名全都不 nice；nice 规则平均分 472–504，最好的非 nice 规则只有 401。
claims.quote: Each of the top eight ranking entries are nice. None of the other entries are nice. There is even a substantial gap in the score between the nice entries and the others. The nice entries received tournament averages between 472 and 504, while the best of the entries that were not nice received only 401 points.
claims.notes: 'nice' 的定义带限定：'if at least it will not be the first to defect before the last few moves (say before move 199)'——Tideman&Chieruzzi、Stein&Rapoport 在最后两步自动背叛仍算 nice。'bottom seven' 包含 RANDOM。

claims.claim: 第一届排名主要由两个'造王者'（kingmaker）决定：DOWNING 和 GRAASKAMP；nice 规则对 RANDOM 的得分极差只有 157，对 DOWNING 达 443、对 GRAASKAMP 290。
claims.quote: The range of scores achieved by the nice programs with RANDOM was only 157, compared t o a range of443 achieved with DOWNINGand 290 achieved with GRAASKAMP.
claims.notes: 这一点直接支持'结果依赖参赛池'的批评：排名几乎由两条本身表现不佳的规则决定。

claims.claim: TFT 在单场对局中会输给对手：第一届 TFT 对 JOSS 的示例对局 TFT 236 : JOSS 241；五局平均 TFT 225 : JOSS 230。
claims.quote: The final score of this game was 236 for TIT FOR TAT and 241 for JOSS. Notice that while JOSS did a little better than TIT FOR TAT, both did poorly. ... In the five games between them, the average scores aere 225 for TIT FOR TAT and 230 for JOSS.
claims.notes: 这是'TFT 从不赢任何单个对手'的一手实例（OCR 'aere'=were）。注意 JOSS 最终排第 12（304 分）——赢了 TFT 的人整体却很差。

claims.claim: 'TFT 不可能在单个对局中得分超过对手'：Axelrod 本人 2011/2012 回顾中明确如此表述；Rapoport, Seale & Colman 2015 用第一届数据按'胜场数'重新排名，TFT 一场未赢、排最后（第15）。
claims.quote: The most fascinating point was that TIT FOR TAT won the tournaments even though it could never do better than the player it was interacting with. Instead it won by its success at eliciting cooperation.
claims.source_title: Axelrod, R. Launching 'The Evolution of Cooperation'. Journal of Theoretical Biology 299 (2012) 21-24 (online 2011)
claims.notes: 严格表述：确定性 TFT 对任何对手的得分 ≤ 对手（最多落后一次 T−S=5 分），可以平局但不能赢。PLOS ONE 2015 原句 'TFT did not score even a single win' 及 'can never achieve a positive point difference'（WebFetch 摘录，未逐字对 PDF）。Wikipedia 引 1984 书 p.130 'won, not by doing better than the other player, but by eliciting cooperation'（二手）。

claims.claim: TIT FOR TWO TATS（只在对手连续两次背叛后才背叛）若参赛将赢得第一届：在 15 条规则的环境中平均 532 分（TFT 504）；它恰恰是寄给所有潜在参赛者的示例程序，但无人提交。同样'会赢'的还有 REVISED DOWNING（542）和预赛冠军 LOOK AHEAD（520）。
claims.quote: The sample program sent to prospective contestants to show them how t o make a submission would in fact have won the tournament if anyone had simply clipped it and mailed it in! But no one did. ... In the environment of the 15 rules of the tournament, REVISED DOWNING averages 542 points. This compares t o T I T FOR TAT which won with 504 points. TIT FOR TWO TATS averages 532 in the same environment. and LOOK AHEAD averages 520 points.
claims.notes: 口径：这是'把它放进既定 15 条规则的环境'的反事实计算，不是重跑（加入它不会改变其他参赛者的提交，但 Axelrod 在脚注3自己承认若条件不同参赛者会提交不同程序）。三个都比 TFT 好，Axelrod 自己据此警告'against the facile belief than an eye for an eye is necessarily the best strategy'。Wikipedia《Tit for tat》称 TF2T 是 Axelrod 'during his second round of computer simulations at RAND' 提出——与原文不符（是第一届的示例程序，Axelrod 在 Michigan）。

claims.claim: 第一届参赛者事先就知道 TFT 很强：他们收到了预赛报告（TFT 在预赛得第二、在其变体中得第一），许多人以 TFT 为基础试图改进它。
claims.quote: In a preliminary tournament, TIT FOR TAT scored second place, and in a variant of that preliminary tournament, TIT FOR TAT won first place. All of these properties were known to most of the people designing programs for the Computer Prisoner's Dilemma Tourna- ment, because they were sent copies of the description of a preliminary tournament. And not surprisingly, many of them used the TIT FOR TAT principle and tried to improve upon it.
claims.notes: 这让'第一届 TFT 是出人意料的黑马'的叙事需要修正：它在预赛中已有表现，参赛者知情；'惊讶'在于复杂改进版全都不如它。

claims.claim: 收益矩阵的具体数值会影响第一届结果：若 P 从 1 改为 2，Tideman & Chieruzzi 将第一，TFT 降至第四。
claims.quote: if P is changed from I to 2, then TIDEMAN AND CHIERUZZI would have come in first, followed by STEIN AND RAPOPORT, FRIEDhlAN. and TIT FOR TAT. Of course, the entrants knew the actual payoff matrix.
claims.notes: Axelrod 自己的 caveat，埋在脚注里。可作为'方法论批评并非事后才有'的证据。同文结尾：'the results of a single tournament are not definitive'。

claims.claim: 第二届有 62 份参赛（来自 6 个国家），加 RANDOM 共 63 条规则；多数参赛者是计算机爱好者，也有进化生物学、物理学、计算机科学教授及第一届的五个学科。
claims.quote: This time there were 62 entries from six countries (23). Most of the contestants were computer hobbyists, but there were also professors of evolutionary biology, physics, and computer science, as well as the five disciplines represented in the first round.
claims.source_title: Axelrod, R. & Hamilton, W. D. (1981). The Evolution of Cooperation. Science 211(4489): 1390-1396 (JSTOR scan, course copy)
claims.notes: 1980b 原文未能取得（SAGE 付费墙）；1980b 摘要（IDEAS/RePEc）写 'The 62 entrants were able to draw lessons from the results of the first round'。63 = 62+RANDOM（Rapoport, Seale & Colman 2015: '63 programs (including RANDOM)'；Axelrod 2012 回顾也写 'the 63 rules of the second round'）。课程讲义转述书中国家为 US, Canada, Great Britain, Norway, Switzerland, New Zealand，并称最年轻者为十岁计算机爱好者（二手，未核原书）。

claims.claim: 第二届参赛者都拿到了第一届的详细分析结果（包括 TIT FOR TWO TATS 等'本可获胜'的补充规则），而且彼此知道对方也知道。
claims.quote: The 62 entrants were able to draw lessons from the results of the first round and were able to design their entries to take these lessons into account.
claims.source_title: Axelrod, R. (1980b). More Effective Choice in the Prisoner's Dilemma. JCR 24(3): 379-403 — abstract
claims.notes: 引文仅为摘要。'were all given the detailed analysis of the first round' 及包含补充规则的细节见 1984 书第2章（经 IIT Kanpur 书摘页与 Brooklyn CUNY 讲义二手转述，未核原书）。Science 1981：'The results of the first round were then circulated and entries for a second round were solicited.' 注意：知情 ≠ '所有人都试图打败 TFT'——没有一手文本支持后者；书中描述的是参赛者从不同'教训'出发（有人更宽容如 TF2T，有人如 TESTER 去剥削宽容者）。

claims.claim: 第二届改为概率结束：每步后结束概率 0.00346（继续概率 w = .99654），设定目的是使对局长度中位数为 200 步；每对仍对局 5 次。
claims.quote: In the second round, the length of the games was uncertain, with an expected probability of 200 moves. This was achieved by setting the probability that a given move would not be the last at w = .99654. As in the first round, each pair was matched in five games (24).
claims.notes: 口径冲突：Science 写 'expected probability of 200 moves'（措辞含糊，像是期望值）；Knight et al. 2025 引 1980b 原文为 'This parameter was chosen so that the expected median length of a game would be 200 moves'。数学上 w=.99654 → 中位数 ln0.5/ln w ≈ 200.0，期望长度 1/(1−w) ≈ 289。所以'平均 200 步'是错的，'中位数 200 步'才对。

claims.claim: 第二届实际并未每局独立随机抽长度：Axelrod 事先抽了 5 个对局长度用于所有配对；1980b 只列出 63、77、151、308 四个（第五个据报告平均值 151 推算为 156）——实际平均长度约 151，短于 200。
claims.quote: the five games for each pair of players would be of lengths 63, 77, 151, and 308
claims.source_title: Knight, V. et al. (2025). Reviving, reproducing, and revisiting Axelrod's second tournament. arXiv:2510.15438 (quoting Axelrod 1980b)
claims.notes: 引文是 Knight 等转引 1980b，经 WebFetch 摘录，未对 1980b 原件核对。'156' 是 Knight 等推断值，非 Axelrod 所写。

claims.claim: 第二届 TFT 再次获胜，由 Anatol Rapoport 再次提交；Science 1981 将其单位写为维也纳高等研究院（IAS Vienna），而书中写作 University of Toronto——两处一手文本的单位不一致。
claims.quote: TIT FOR TAT was again submitted by the winner of the first round, Professor Anatol Rapoport of the Institute for Advanced Study (Vienna). It won again.
claims.notes: 1984 书版本（经 IIT Kanpur 书摘页二手）：'TIT FOR TAT was again sent in by the winner of the first round, Anatol Rapoport of the University of Toronto. Again it won.' Rapoport 1979–80 前后任维也纳 IHS 所长，两者可能都'对'只是时点不同；文章中最好不写单位或注明。egtheory 2015 博客称 Rapoport 是第二届'唯一（再）提交 TFT 的人'——未找到一手文本支持，存疑。

claims.claim: 第二届前列：1 TFT (Rapoport)、2 Danny C. Champion、3 Otto Borufsen、4 Rob Cave、5 William Adams……；TIT FOR TWO TATS 由 John Maynard Smith 提交，排第 24。
claims.quote: Submitted to Axelrod's second tournament by John Maynard Smith; it came in 24th in that tournament.
claims.source_title: Axelrod-Python library, TitFor2Tats docstring; Knight et al. 2025 Table 1
claims.notes: 排名表来自 Knight et al. 2025（基于 Axelrod 公布的 Fortran 源码代号 k92r=TFT, k61r=Champion, k90r=Maynard Smith）。'24th' 应出自 1984 书第2章，未能核对原书。这是'TF2T 本能赢第一届'的反讽对照：真正参赛时在更具剥削性的环境里落到第 24。

claims.claim: 第二届 TFT 的成功被归于三点：从不率先背叛、可被激怒而报复、报复一次后即宽恕；书中总结为四性质：nice, retaliatory, forgiving, clear。
claims.quote: the analysis of the 3 million choices which were made in the second round identified the impressive robustness of TIT FOR TAT as dependent on three features: it was never the first to defect, it was provocable into retaliation by a defection of the other, and it was forgiving after just one act of retaliation (24).
claims.notes: 1984 书 p.54（经 Rapoport, Seale & Colman 2015 引用）：'What accounts for TIT FOR TAT's robust success is its combination of being nice, retaliatory, forgiving, and clear.' —— 第四个性质 clear 在 1981 Science 的三点里没有，是书中才加的。1980b 摘要用 'provocable' 而非 'retaliatory'。'3 million choices' 与书中'over a million moves'（二手讲义）一致：每步两人各一个选择。

claims.claim: 1984 书第6章给出的四条建议原文措辞：Don't be envious. / Don't be the first to defect. / Reciprocate both cooperation and defection. / Don't be too clever.
claims.quote: Don't be envious. ... Don't be the first to defect. ... Reciprocate both cooperation and defection. ... Don't be too clever.
claims.source_title: Axelrod 1984, The Evolution of Cooperation, ch.6 'How to Choose Effectively'（经 Wikiquote 转录）
claims.notes: 未能取得原书文本（archive.org 为借阅限制；Google Books API 配额为 0）。Wikipedia 给出页码 'don't be envious' pp.110–113, 'don't be too clever' pp.120+。注意'四性质'(nice/retaliatory/forgiving/clear, 第2章 p.54) 与'四建议'(第6章) 是两套不同表述，不能混为一谈；书中还有第7–9章其他建议。

claims.claim: 第二届中 nice 与否和成绩高度相关：前 15 名中除一个外都是 nice（那一个排第8）。
claims.quote: Of the all top fifteen rules, all but one were nice (and that one ranked the eighth.)
claims.source_title: Azhar, M. Q. (2005) 课堂讲义 'The Success of TIT FOR TAT in Computer Tournaments'（转述 Axelrod 1984 第2章）
claims.notes: 学生讲义转述原书，未核 1980b/原书原文。核查方需找原书第2章。同一讲义把 TFT 写成'only five lines of Fortan'——与 1980a 的四行矛盾，说明该讲义可靠性有限。

claims.claim: 1980b 的'代表性'假设锦标赛：构造 6 个变体（每个让某一类规则大量过量出现），TFT 赢了其中 5 个、第 6 个排第二。
claims.quote: The results were that TIT FOR TAT won five of the six variants of the tournaments and came in second in the sixth.
claims.source_title: Azhar 2005 讲义（转述 Axelrod 1984/1980b）；egtheory 博客 2015 同说
claims.notes: 1980b 摘要一手确认存在此分析：'An analysis of hypothetical alternative tournaments demonstrates the robustness of the results.' 但 '5/6' 数字只有二手来源（egtheory: 'TIT-for-TAT still came out on top 5 out of the 6 times, coming in 2nd in the last variant'）。这些变体仍由同 63 条规则加权构成，并非真正不同的参赛池——这是 Binmore 'why restrict ourselves to Axelrod's 63 strategies?' 批评的靶子。

claims.claim: 生态（未来世代）模拟：以第二届 63 条规则为初始，每代各规则份额按上一代得分比例更新；Science 1981 称长期 TFT 取代其他规则、走向固定（fixation）；但 1980b 原文报告的是到第1000代 TFT 占 14.5% 且仍以每代 0.05% 增长。
claims.quote: The results showed that, as the less successful rules were displaced, TIT FOR TAT continued to do well with the rules which initially scored near the top. In the long run, TIT FOR TAT displaced all the other rules and went to fixation (24).
claims.notes: 关键口径冲突！1980b p.401（经检索摘要转引 PS: Political Science & Politics 的 Axelrod 传记）：'By the 1000th generation, it was 14.5% of the whole population . . . and was still growing at .05% per generation which was a faster rate than any other rule'——未能直接核对（传记 PDF 走代理被拦，1980b 付费）。Binmore 1998：TFT 'controls only a little more than 1/6 of the population'，'Actually a mixture of strategies survives'。Hoffmann 2000 JASSS 称第1000代'reciprocating cooperators accounted for about 75%'。即：1000 代时 TFT 只是最大份额（约 1/7–1/6），'went to fixation' 是 Science 对更长期的外推表述。

claims.claim: Axelrod & Hamilton 1981 的稳定性主张：当相遇继续概率 w 足够大时 TFT '进化稳定'，充要条件为 w ≥ (T−R)/(T−P) 且 w ≥ (T−R)/(R−S)；论证方法是只需检查 ALL D 和 DC 交替两种策略能否入侵。
claims.quote: neither of these two strategies (and hence no strategy at all) can invade TIT FOR TAT if and only if both w > (T - R)/(T - P) and w > (T - R)/(R - S) (1) This demonstrates that TIT FOR TAT is evolutionarily stable if and only if the interactions between the individuals have a sufficiently large probability of continuing (19).
claims.notes: OCR 把不等号印成 '>' 和 '-'，原刊应为 ≥（第二个式子 OCR 损坏，需看扫描图核对）。代入 3/5/1/0：两个阈值分别 1/2 和 2/3，所以 w ≥ 2/3。Science 用的是'evolutionarily stable'，但'不可被入侵'只指不被严格超越（Nash 意义）；ALL C 等 nice 策略对 TFT 是中性突变体，TFT 不是 Maynard Smith 严格意义的 ESS。1984 书改称 'collectively stable'（Proposition 2：'TIT FOR TAT is collectively stable if and only if, w is large enough'，经 Wikiquote）。Boyd & Lorberbaum 1987 Nature 327:58–59：'No pure strategy is evolutionarily stable in the repeated Prisoner's Dilemma game'。另：Science 原文说 ALL D 'is evolutionarily stable no matter what is the probability of interaction continuing'。

claims.claim: Science 1981 给出的初始可行性机制：亲缘关系，或聚簇（cluster）——当 p 和 w 足够大时，一小簇 TFT 可在几乎全是 ALL D 的环境中立足；且 nice 的稳定策略不能被任何簇入侵（'棘轮'）。
claims.quote: When p and w are large enough, a cluster of TIT FOR TAT individuals can then become initially viable in an environment composed overwhelmingly of ALL D (19).
claims.notes: OCR 两栏交错，引文已按语义复原。'The gear wheels of social evolution have a ratchet.' 也在同段。

claims.claim: Axelrod 自己承认原锦标赛没有'噪声'（选择被误执行/误感知），只在策略层面放了 RANDOM；他称这是简单互惠的'basic flaw'，并希望早点意识到。
claims.quote: I wish I had appreciated this basic flaw in simple reciprocity earlier. I did not entirely ignore the problem of noise, but I had introduced it in the tournament at the level of the strategy rather than at the level of the choice.
claims.notes: 与 NOISE 线交叉。Axelrod 引 Molander 1985：小噪声下两 TFT 的平均收益等同两个 RANDOM。

claims.claim: Binmore（1998 书评）批评：TFT 在 Axelrod 模拟中'没那么成功'，其有限成功在初始参赛池变化时不稳健；核心结论（重复博弈可支撑合作）在 Axelrod 之前已为人熟知超过 25 年（folk theorem）；Axelrod 列出的性质中只有'retaliatory'是必要的。
claims.quote: On examination, it turns out that TIT-FOR-TAT was not so very successful in Axelrod's simulation. Nor is the limited success it does enjoy robust when the initial population of entries is varied.
claims.source_title: Binmore, K. (1998). Review of Axelrod, The Complexity of Cooperation. JASSS 1(1)
claims.notes: 引文由 WebFetch 摘录，判断为逐字，但未做第二次字节级核对。其他句：'But this fact had been well known for more than a quarter of a century before Axelrod began to write on the subject.'；'All that is then left on Axelrod's list is the requirement that a successful strategy be retaliatory.'

claims.claim: Rapoport, Seale & Colman (2015, PLOS ONE) 用第一届 15 条规则做两阶段（3组×5）循环赛的全部 756,756 种分组：TFT 只赢 11.0%，Tideman&Chieruzzi 30.0%，Stein&Rapoport 24.8%；结论是 TFT 的有效性取决于赛制、成功标准和收益数值。
claims.quote: is contingent on the design of the tournament, the criterion used to determine success, and the particular values
claims.source_title: Rapoport, Amnon; Seale, D. A.; Colman, A. M. (2015). Is Tit-for-Tat the Answer? On the Conclusions Drawn from Axelrod's Tournaments. PLOS ONE 10(7): e0134128
claims.notes: 数字经 WebFetch 摘录，未逐字对 PDF。注意作者 Amnon Rapoport 本人是第一届第6名 STEIN AND RAPOPORT 的共同提交者——有利益相关可提，但其重分析对象就是 1980a 公开数据。

claims.claim: Knight 等 2025 用 Axelrod 公开的 Fortran 源码重跑第二届 25,000 次：TFT 仍是原排名/复现排名第一，但只在 63.3% 的随机种子下夺冠；Axelrod 报告的精确结果无法复现；第二名 Champion 的代码有变量未初始化的 bug（复现排名第12）。
claims.quote: Although Axelrod's reported results are impossible to replicate, we are able to recover the main conclusions.
claims.notes: WebFetch 摘录；预印本未经同行评审。'It is unclear whether this bug affected the tournament results reported in 1980.' 与 EVIDENCE/现代复现线交叉。

open_questions: 1980b 原文（JCR 24(3):379-403）未能取得：TFT 第二届具体得分、'nice'在第二届的精确统计、6 个代表性变体的定义与 5/6 结果、生态模拟 14.5%/0.05% 的原句（p.401）都只有二手转引。核查方若有 SAGE/JSTOR 访问请优先核这些。
Science 1981 说生态模拟中 TFT 'went to fixation'；1980b（转引）说第1000代仅 14.5% 且仍在增长；Binmore 说'略多于 1/6'；Hoffmann 说互惠合作者合计约 75%。四个数字口径不同（TFT 单一规则 vs 一类规则；1000代 vs 极限），文章必须注明是哪一个。
第二届对局长度：'平均 200 步'（Science 措辞）vs '中位数 200 步'（1980b，经转引）vs 实际 5 个预抽长度平均约 151。文章应写'设计中位数 200'。
Rapoport 第二届署名单位：Science 'Institute for Advanced Study (Vienna)' vs 1984 书 'University of Toronto'（书摘二手）。
第一届'14 个参赛'是否含 RANDOM：一手明确不含（14+RANDOM=15）；部分二手（Tesfatsion 2003）写成含 RANDOM；PLOS 2015 写成'14 scientists'（实为16人）。
Science 1981 稳定性不等式 OCR 损坏：需看扫描原图确认是 ≥ 还是 >；以及 Science 用'evolutionarily stable'与书中'collectively stable'的术语差异及其严格性（Selten & Hammerstein 1984; Boyd & Lorberbaum 1987）。
TF2T 第二届'第24名、Maynard Smith 提交'只见于 Axelrod-Python 文档，需对书第2章原文。
'Rapoport 是第二届唯一提交 TFT 的人'（egtheory 博客）无一手依据。
'第二届参赛者都想打败 TFT'无一手依据：一手只说他们拿到第一届分析并'draw lessons'；书中描述的策略方向各异。
